root_motivation: **Who:** the agent at the end of a session that knows something its next self will not. **What:** leave a note where the next reader will trip over it -- pinned to a tool's description in tools/list, on any client, with no extra call.
user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a live keyed connection to a test server, When `host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool: "cleaner"}}` succeeds, Then the server sent `notifications/tools/list_changed` on that connection and the next `tools/list` describes `cleaner` with the ` — note to self: ` suffix (the falsifier).
Given a 300-char note attached to a tool, When `tools/list` renders, Then the suffix text is exactly 120 chars ending in `…`, cut at a char boundary, and `host.note.list` still returns the full text.
Given a tenant at `notes_max`, When `host.note.put` is called, Then `quota_exceeded` with `{limit, used}` and no row is written; Given `attach_to: {tool: "nope"}`, Then `not_found`.
Given a note with `ttl_s: 60` and the clock advanced 61 s, When `host.note.list` and `tools/list` run before the sweep, Then neither shows it; When the sweep runs, Then the row is gone.

scope: src/notes.rs: host.note.put/list/delete over the notes/ prefix of tenant_state_kv; the tools/list description suffix.
src/handler.rs, src/protocol/frames.rs: tools, dispatch, list_changed on a tool-attached put/delete (keyed row allows list_changed).
src/plans.rs, src/retention.rs, src/db.rs: notes_max plan field; expired-note sweep.
contracts/, docs/, www/: regenerated tool contract, output schemas, docs.
non_goals: Notes attached to runs surfaced in host.runs.get (R6), attached_to in host.resume/welcome_back (R5), pin (R7); shared notebooks across tenants.

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the next session repeat a mistake the last one learned from?
five_whys_trace.a: The only write path is remember at signup; nothing pins a note to the tool it is about.
